title: A build rejected on a resumed cycle is still recorded with no code, so it releases the item uncharged
summary: PR #1079 codes an in-cycle build rejection as BUILD_DELIVERABLE_REJECTED (core rejectAfterCorrections). The resume path does not: reviewResumedDeliverable (go/internal/core/resume.go:329) returns a plain error, and the generic error branch of resume_execution.go:191 records phaseOutcomeFrom with no code. A resumed rejected build therefore still classifies as system-level, and the item is redrawn with no failure_count. The failure is toward no charge, the same as before #1079.
fix: Return a typed rejection error from reviewResumedDeliverable, and record the build outcome through rejectedOutcome in resume_execution.go when that error comes back. The classifier already lets infrastructure evidence outrank the code (YieldsToInfra).
acceptance: A resumed cycle whose build is rejected after its corrections records the build entry as a FAIL with BUILD_DELIVERABLE_REJECTED (red today)
The same resumed rejection with an infrastructure marker classifies as infrastructure
